slices.focus: Follow-up confirms reflux improvement; focus shifts to sleep and neck.
slices.summary: A follow-up clinic visit confirms Jae-hyun's reflux is less frequent and more controlled thanks to regular meal timing and simpler food. However, broken sleep before storm nights and persistent neck tension from the radio desk remain disruptive. He adopts a tiny pre-sleep sequence (10-minute neck/shoulder routine, no heavy food, bed) and keeps a quiet corner at home as a decompression landing spot.
